name: Symphony of Redemption
source:
The protagonist once lived with his parents in Z Town, but frequently moved after his father became more successful. When his father’s affair surfaced, chaos erupted over the family’s overseas business. To avoid the turmoil, the protagonist’s grandfather took him in and trained him in martial arts, academics, and survival skills. 

After his grandfather’s death, the protagonist was placed under his father’s custody; however, he was full of resentment toward his father. In the end, he chose to live with his aunt in Z town. From there, he reunited with his childhood friend and crossed paths with the school’s most beautiful troublemaker. Who will you choose? A sweet but dangerous yandere childhood friend? Or a hot and cold tomboyish Yankee that everyone feared?
